trap.label: whose duplo
trap.wrong: The company whose its profits fell is closing.
trap.right: The company whose profits fell is closing.
trap.why: Em português “cujos lucros” não repete o pronome, mas o aluno que evita cujo diz “que seus lucros”. Em inglês, whose substitui o possessivo.

mcq.q: “___ the council invested, it would still be open.”

opts: If I would leave, I had been there.
If I left, I would be there then.
If I had left, I would be there now.

fix.wrong: They singled out him for blame.
fix.right: They singled him out for blame.

fix.wrong: The report, that is long, is dull.
fix.right: The report, which is long, is dull.

fix.wrong: If I would be you, I would sign.
fix.right: If I were you, I would sign.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com inversão: “If the council had invested, it would be open.”
rewrite.answer: Had the council invested, it would be open.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com whose: “I know a man. His car is blue.”
rewrite.answer: I know a man whose car is blue.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com single out e o pronome it: “They highlighted the problem.”
